context: A uni student coaches a teen friend through self-doubt
purpose: Teach: 抱か/疑っ/なにやら/至ら/気がつく/引き出す/種々/大人気

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、なにやら最近うまくいかなくて、自分に自信が持てなくて不安ばかり感じちゃうんです。
lines.en: Senpai, somehow things haven't been going well lately, and I can't have confidence in myself, so I just keep feeling anxious.
lines.style: Soft hesitant teen voice trailing into a sigh

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 話を聞くたびに気がつくんだけど、さくらって自分の才能を疑ってばかりだよね。
lines.en: Every time I hear you, I notice it again — Sakura, you're always doubting your own talent.
lines.style: Gentle warm uni-student tone, observational and caring

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: だって至らない部分ばかり目について、いろんな失敗を思い出しちゃうんですよ。
lines.en: It's because I only notice my shortcomings, and I end up remembering all kinds of failures.
lines.style: Slightly choked teenage voice, defensive but vulnerable

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 頭の中で種々の不安を抱かないようにしても、すぐ戻ってきちゃって。
lines.en: Even if I try not to hold all these various anxieties in my head, they come right back.
lines.style: Quiet trembling teen voice, hands clasped tightly together

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: でもさ、この前の合唱でさくらのソロ、クラスで大人気だったじゃん。
lines.en: But hey, your solo at the recent chorus event was super popular with the class, right?
lines.style: Bright encouraging tone, leaning forward with a smile

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あれは……たまたまで、本当の実力じゃないと思って。
lines.en: That was... just luck, I don't think it reflects my real ability.
lines.style: Quiet teen voice, eyes lowered, almost whispering

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: たまたまじゃないって。自分の中にある良いものを引き出すのが、これから大事なんだよ。
lines.en: It wasn't luck. From now on, what matters is drawing out the good things inside yourself.
lines.style: Steady reassuring uni-student voice, slowly emphatic

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ……先輩にそう言ってもらえると、少しだけ前向きになれる気がします。
lines.en: ...When you say that, senpai, I feel like I can be a little more positive.
lines.style: Soft teen voice warming with a small relieved smile
